evidence.title: Deterministic bounded UGTOMS SCLP reference replay

failure_modes.condition: A value lies outside a declared numeric, grammar, generation, or packing domain.
failure_modes.handling: Reject the operation before committing state or lineage.
failure_modes.observable: The responsible primitive raises an explicit bounded-domain error.

failure_modes.condition: A branch, LUT, display, recipe, or generation budget would be exceeded.
failure_modes.handling: Stop or retain the bounded prefix; do not materialize unbounded state.
failure_modes.observable: The route is marked unbounded or the codec rejects the request.

failure_modes.condition: Support, compatibility, or guard crossing cannot be certified.
failure_modes.handling: Return INDETERMINATE and retain the previous authoritative state.
failure_modes.observable: The event decision has status INDETERMINATE.

geometry.definition: Evaluate an exact finite filled right-circular cone SDF and a separate sphere support SDF at the causal kinematic state.

kinematic.definition: Use the spatial log-polar metric calculus to construct vectors, then advance one constant-acceleration linear-time step.

operator.definition: Execute a finite content-addressed definition DAG and bind fixed recipe opcodes to hashed meanings.

packing.definition: Pack 20/18/14/12 pose fields, four signed16 motion lanes, an optional shared binary16 LUT, and one fixed bounded recipe.

predicate.definition: Keep payload parity, topology parity, jitter control, and branch control distinct; admit events through support, compatibility, and guard certificates.

self_reference.definition: Commit one source-grounded observable generation through an explicit FeedbackEdge from n to n+1; no same-generation cycle or fixed-point engine is present.

topology.definition: Apply the declared reflective Klein gluing and route a separate branch-control bit through a bounded BST-T decision.

typed.definition: Compose distinct continuous, discrete, and quality fields through one validated generation with explicit units and failures.

vector.definition: Represent velocity and acceleration as explicit VectorArrow3 values in the declared Cartesian frame and metre-based units.

profile_selection_rationale: NHDF v0.1 supplies the normalized next-generation operator chain, while sclp-foundational supplies the finite-cone, log-polar metric, one-bit guard, and bounded packing semantics exercised by this application.

resource_bounds.enforcement: FeedbackEdge requires target_generation equals source_generation plus one.
BSTTRouter refuses bifurcation when either declared branch bound would be exceeded.
LogPolarProfile validates the resolution and SharedLogPolarLUT requires canonical bytes.

resource_bounds.resource: authored recipe instances including the prototype

resource_bounds.enforcement: generated_display_instances returns only the requested deterministic prefix and rejects counts above the recipe.
